# VerseMate

> VerseMate is a free Bible reading companion from VerseMate, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Every chapter of the Bible comes with its text, a summary and a verse-by-verse explanation. The life of Jesus and Bible topics are explained the same way. It is available on the web, on iOS and on Android.

The content lives on the web reader at https://app.versemate.org. This site, versemate.org, is about the nonprofit and its apps.

## Full index

- [VerseMate reader llms.txt](https://app.versemate.org/llms.txt): every book, Jesus event and topic, each linked to its Markdown version.

## URL patterns

- A Bible chapter: `https://app.versemate.org/bible/{book}/{chapter}`, for example [Matthew 5](https://app.versemate.org/bible/matthew/5) or [John 3](https://app.versemate.org/bible/john/3). The book is its English name in lowercase with hyphens (`1-corinthians`, `song-of-solomon`).
- An event in the life of Jesus: `https://app.versemate.org/jesus/event/{event}`, for example [The baptism of Jesus](https://app.versemate.org/jesus/event/event-baptism).
- A topic: `https://app.versemate.org/topic/{category}/{topic}`, for example [The Creation of the World](https://app.versemate.org/topic/events/the-creation-of-the-world).

## Markdown versions

Every page above has a Markdown version at the same address with `.md` appended, for example https://app.versemate.org/bible/matthew/5.md. The page's own address also answers with Markdown when the request sends `Accept: text/markdown`. Each page names its Markdown version in a `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` tag.
